data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the annual subscription "Muster Magazin". The total due is €61.90, including a €2.50 reminder fee, payable by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says the annual fee for your magazine subscription (1 June 2025 – 31 May 2026) is still unpaid. They added a €2.50 reminder fee. Please transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. If you have already paid, you can ignore the letter. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's customer service. Check that the bank details match those from your original subscription documents before paying.
